theorems.name: Submission.cbrld_measure_eq_zero_of_small_fillings
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P d : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (κ lam : ℝ) (E : Set (Euclid P)), 0 ≤ κ → κ < 1 → 1 ≤ lam → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → C.massOn W = μ W) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < δ ∧ μ (sphere x ρ) = 0 ∧ ∃ (A S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), A ω = ∫ y in ball x ρ, ξ y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) y) ∂μ) ∧ S.boundary = A.boundary ∧ S.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal κ * μ (ball x ρ) ∧ S.support ⊆ closedBall x (lam * δ)) → μ E = 0
